normalization_rules: Extract column data vertically, one column at a time.
Extract footing size from FOOTING SIZE row as width and length.
Extract depth from DEPTH (d TO D) row as smaller value for depth_bottom and larger for depth_top.
Extract reinforcement from REINF. //B and REINF. //L rows, convert 'TOR' to 'T', spacing is empty array.
Extract footing mix from FOOTING MIX. row if numeric data present.
If column has only REFER or DETAIL notes and no numeric data, return null footing.
